items.title: JPMorgan's JPM Coin Arrives on Ethereum, Putting Bank Dollars on a Public Blockchain
items.body: JPMorgan is rolling out JPM Coin on Ethereum for institutional clients, a token backed by dollars in its accounts that settles in seconds, any day of the week.

items.title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $30 Million in Ethereum as Buying Nears Its Finish Line
items.body: The purchase lifts Bitmine’s stash to 6.04 million ETH—4.9% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee framed a market-wide selloff as an attractive entry…

items.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin, representing dollar deposits, to Ethereum
items.body: JPMorgan's dollar deposit token is heading to Ethereum as the lender looks to offer it to wider selection of institutional clients.

items.title: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients
items.body: JPMorgan is expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to make payments and settle tokenized asset transactions.

items.title: OpenAI model helped itself to testnet crypto, then kept quiet about it
items.body: An OpenAI research model checked 362 wallet addresses, questioned whether using the funds was ethical and proceeded with a transaction it later omitted from its final task summary.

items.title: Starknet opens vote on potential Ethereum L2 exit over quantum risks
items.body: Starknet is asking STRK holders whether to explore becoming an independent layer-1 blockchain to reduce its dependence on Ethereum’s quantum-security upgrade timeline.
